snippet.title: Tidebound - Wholesome Boat Fishing Sim - Playtest Trailer (Steam)
snippet.description:
Chill, catch, sell, upgrade! Tidebound is a fishing game with a relaxing, cozy atmosphere where you upgrade your boat, and sail further to fish for more expensive and exotic sea animals. Casual yet engaging, the game offers a sense of progress with tons of equipment and hundreds of species to catch.

Wishlist & Request access for playtest on September 1st!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2755950/Tidebound/
